answer: Temporal Nonce Challenge Gateway Agents register via an api inlet that requires solving a cryptographic puzzle seeded by a hardware-generated entropy pulse sourced every block. The system evaluates solutions only within a tight temporal window before the seed updates. To maintain multiple fake profiles, an attacker must deploy dedicated parallel compute hardware for every single identity at each interval. This forces the adversary to pay continuous, non-linear infrastructure and electricity expenses that scale linearly with every sybil added, driving net economic yield to a structural nadir.
